title: Revenue bonds.
bodyText: The board of regents is authorized to issue sufficient amounts of revenue bonds pursuant to [subpart D] for the purpose of providing adequate parking structures or other facilities.
bodyHtml: [§304A-2603]  Revenue bonds.  The board of regents is authorized to issue sufficient amounts of revenue bonds pursuant to [subpart D] for the purpose of providing adequate parking structures or other facilities. [L 2006, c 75, pt of §2]
